column8: How the figure was derived from the source
Value × (1 − 30%) × (1/36 + 9.4%/12). Check vs BFI example: IDR 210m financed × (1/36 + 0.094/12) = IDR 7.48m/month = BFI table (IDR 7,480,000).
30% deposit + (1.25% provision + 1% commitment) × financed + IDR 350k fees + 0.25% p.a. insurance × 3 years.
Guests/day × coffee units per 100 guests ÷ 100 × 18 g × 1.1 × trading days.

11% VAT on rental and bean premium is not recoverable (PBJT regime) → added in col U. Finance-lease instalments are a financial service (no VAT); VAT is inside the financed value. 2% PPh 23 on rentals is withheld, not an extra cost.

Cash view: all lease/rental/sponsor payments run through fixed costs (PnL row 34), so EBITDA is conservative (under PSAK 73 a finance lease sits below EBITDA). Only route-1 items are depreciated (col N = 1).
